research_role: prospective six-pair development comparison plus one consumed descriptive pair and one unavailable-revision censoring; not held-out, confirmatory, or SOTA evidence

arms.B-FSR: one continuous free-search Agent session with advisory complete-program clean replay
arms.C-GCI: B-FSR plus prompt-guided early programization, retention of each clean-replay-passed program, and certified-incumbent fallback

primary_end_to_end_result.interpretation: The small development batch does not establish a population effect, but it falsifies the claim that the bundled C-GCI policy is a non-regressive improvement over B-FSR.

mechanism_evidence.observation_note: Construction-time full-root goal passes were directly recognizable in five episodes per arm. Bread C and Mamonsu B formed replay-certified candidates without a parser-recognized construction-time full-root pass.

decisive_qibolab_trajectory.observation_layer: The active environment produced a complete full-root zero-missing-import observation at request 93.
decisive_qibolab_trajectory.constraint_layer: The prompt did not convert that verified success into a durable case-local obligation to deliver the current sufficient state before optional exploration.
decisive_qibolab_trajectory.operation_layer: The Agent continued broad dependency, hardware, stub, and runtime-completeness work until the request cap and never invoked complete-program replay.
decisive_qibolab_trajectory.causal_boundary: The incumbent machinery could act only after a clean replay pass. Since no candidate was proposed, no incumbent existed and fallback could not rescue the episode.

adjudication.clean_target_state_replay: retain as an activated component with prior Fail-to-Pass evidence
adjudication.next_algorithmic_hypothesis: A trusted full-goal Pass should trigger a controller-owned programization and replay phase inside the same active Agent session. Search and repair remain free; the controller owns only the transition from a verified sufficient construction state to a complete replayable program.
adjudication.why_this_is_not_another_compatibility_ru: The intervention does not prescribe packages, interpreters, commands, or repository-specific repairs. It repairs a generic control-flow failure between Observation, Constraint, and Operation.
adjudication.implementation_boundary: Do not add package rules, cross-case memory, physical checkpoints, candidate graphs, or harness self-modification. First qualify the handoff on consumed traces, then preregister a new fixed development comparison.

descriptive_and_censored.futaba: Consumed descriptive pair; both arms passed Official and cannot support unseen-development claims.
descriptive_and_censored.flask_security: Both arms ended before Agent execution because the remote repository no longer served the requested commit; report as source-acquisition censoring, not algorithm failure.

supported: C-GCI did not improve success or resources over B-FSR in the prospective six-pair development comparison.
A verified satisfying construction state can be lost before candidate formation and replay.
Prompt guidance plus post-replay incumbent retention is not a reliable executable goal trigger.
Official success, deployment completeness, and resource cost must remain separate outcomes.
not_supported: The next verifier-triggered handoff improves success.
Any arm is SOTA on EnvBench.
The result generalizes to protected test cases, other backbones, or native Codex.
